## 2. Technical Stack & Capabilities

### Frontend
- Frameworks: SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5 (with native Runes reactivity: $state, $derived, $effect), React 18/19
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, CSS3, CSS Custom Properties, Neobrutalism Design System
- Languages: TypeScript, Modern JavaScript (ESNext), HTML5
- Motion & Animation: GSAP (GreenSock) with ScrollTrigger & matchMedia, Three.js (interactive 3D physics lanyard & WebGL), Lenis smooth scrolling
- State & Routing: SvelteKit declarative file-based routing, server-side load functions, i18n localization store (ID/EN)

### Backend & APIs
- Environments: Node.js, Python
- APIs: RESTful API design, SvelteKit Server Endpoints (+server.ts), Google AI Studio / Gemini API integration
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL with relational database normalization (3NF)
- Security: Rate limiting, input validation, strict guardrails, environmental secret isolation

### DevOps & Tools

## 3. Architecture & Quality Standards (The Craft)

Hisyam follows 4 core engineering principles when developing digital products:

1. Architecture & Pipeline:
   - Structured layered code from frontend UI to normalized database models.
   - Clean Code principles with strict separation of concerns and type-safe contracts.
2. UI/UX Design & Prototyping:
   - High-fidelity prototyping in Figma before implementation.
   - Responsive design tested across mobile (375px–430px), tablet (768px–820px), and desktop (1024px–1440px+).
   - High accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA, high-contrast borders, focus indicators, keyboard navigation).
3. Performance & Optimization:
   - Core Web Vitals optimization (sub-second LCP, 0 CLS, low INP).
   - Lightweight asset bundling with Vite and dynamic asset lazy loading.
4. Project Management & Delivery:
   - Agile sprint workflow with clear milestone ownership and documentation.

## 7. AI Assistant on Portfolio: Hisyam'AI

Hisyam's portfolio features an integrated AI assistant powered by Google Gemini API:
- Endpoint: POST https://hisyamsayyid.my.id/api/chat
- Capabilities: Answers visitor questions about Hisyam's projects, tech stack, experience, and contact options.
- Guardrails: Strictly scoped to Hisyam's portfolio (refuses out-of-context queries in 1 sentence to conserve tokens).
- Bilingual: Adapts automatically to Indonesian or English based on the active website language.
- Persistence: Preserves chat history in localStorage across page reloads.
- Anti-Spam: Protected by client-side cooldown and server-side IP rate limiting (8 requests/minute).
